changes.title: Request a free evaluation from any phone.
changes.text: The current site is a fixed desktop layout, and the Free Evaluation page has no form, only phone numbers. The concept puts tap to call and a short evaluation request at the top of every screen.

changes.title: One number and every service in plain view.
changes.text: Your pages list three different phone numbers, and the homepage services hide inside pop up boxes. The concept shows every service on the page with one main number.

changes.title: Your team and your promises up front.
changes.text: Your family team photo is a small thumbnail that links to another page, and no contract lock in and an entomologist on staff are buried in the text. The concept leads with them.
